Metadata.title: Maël Devillers — AI-Native Software Engineer
Metadata.description: Software engineer building SaaS, AI products and business software at the speed of AI, with the rigor of real engineering: architecture, security, tests, production.

bio: AI-native software engineer. I build software at the speed of AI, with the standards of real engineering.

About.title: Engineer first. AI-native by default.
About.subtitle: From idea to production, end to end.
paragraphs: I'm Maël, a software engineer and co-founder of Wenoble, with four years of full-stack work behind me.
I use LLMs, agents and Claude Code to move faster, and I own every line that ships: architecture, review, tests, security.
I work across the stack, from TypeScript and Python to Postgres, Docker and Linux servers, and I care about what happens after launch.

Stack.title: The stack I build and ship with.

tools.name: React
tools.description: Component-driven interfaces, from internal dashboards to product UIs, built to stay maintainable.

tools.name: Next.js
tools.description: My default for products: server rendering, routing and APIs in one codebase, ready for production.

tools.name: TypeScript
tools.description: Strict types end to end. It's also what keeps AI-generated code honest and reviewable.

tools.name: Tailwind CSS
tools.description: Styling in the code, with a consistent design system instead of one-off CSS.

tools.name: Webflow
tools.description: Marketing sites teams can edit themselves, with a clean structure and custom code where it counts.

tools.name: Node.js
tools.description: APIs, workers, scripts and integrations on the server: the glue of most products.

tools.name: Express
tools.description: Lightweight APIs, webhooks and services when a full framework would be overkill.

tools.name: NestJS
tools.description: Structured backends for larger APIs: modules, dependency injection, testable architecture.

tools.name: PostgreSQL
tools.description: The database I trust: relational, transactional, and still flexible with JSONB.

tools.name: MongoDB
tools.description: Document storage when data is deeply nested or its shape changes often.

tools.name: Supabase
tools.description: Postgres with auth, storage and access policies built in. Fast to start, solid to scale.

tools.name: Claude
tools.description: My main model: through the API for agents and RAG, through Claude Code to build faster.

tools.name: OpenAI
tools.description: GPT models and embeddings for generation, classification and semantic search.

tools.name: MCP
tools.description: Model Context Protocol: giving agents controlled access to real tools, APIs and data.

tools.name: Vercel
tools.description: A preview on every branch and zero-config production deploys for Next.js apps.

tools.name: Cloudflare
tools.description: DNS, CDN, security and edge workers in front of everything I put online.

tools.name: Docker
tools.description: Reproducible environments, from local development to VPS and production containers.

tools.name: GitHub
tools.description: Code review, CI/CD with Actions and issues to keep every release under control.
